subject: general
question: Mumbai Indians defeated which team to win the Women’s Premier League in March 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Delhi Capitals**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

 
• Royal Challengers Bangalore Women, led by Smriti Mandhana, clinched their maiden WPL title 2024 by defeating **Delhi Capitals**.

 
• A strong spin attack comprising **Shreyanka Patil, Sophie Molineux, Asha Sobhana, and Georgia Wareham **played a pivotal role.
 
• **Delhi Capitals,** despite a strong start, crumbled under RCB
